480ab885-61c1-4787-8654-d23b96356ba7.title: Zeptobars — decapsulated die-shot archive
480ab885-61c1-4787-8654-d23b96356ba7.desc: A long-running blog that acid-decaps commodity and historical chips and publishes high-resolution die photographs as an open archive.

bc4c10db-a44d-4e17-8e15-30e564fe7c57.title: IRIS — infrared, in-situ chip inspection
bc4c10db-a44d-4e17-8e15-30e564fe7c57.desc: Andrew 'bunnie' Huang's method for imaging a chip's internal construction through its package, without desoldering or destroying it.

4f3e636c-2910-46b3-828f-99c084cc5611.title: Installation-view conventions, and artists who push back on them
4f3e636c-2910-46b3-828f-99c084cc5611.desc: An essay on how exhibition documentation photographers shape the art they record, and three artists who deliberately work against that convention.

52124973-fc66-4c72-98ad-7456e239bdc3.title: iFixit teardown photography
52124973-fc66-4c72-98ad-7456e239bdc3.desc: A fixed overhead rig and a numbered step grammar that turn photographs into instructions.

4854a8a2-d71a-466f-993d-3b34cc46cfc6.title: Herbarium specimen imaging — scale and colour calibration
4854a8a2-d71a-466f-993d-3b34cc46cfc6.desc: The standardized scale-bar and colour-reference convention herbaria use so specimen photographs can be measured and compared across institutions.

ea3813a0-0a80-4f6f-ae21-d388eb38832a.title: Fritzchens Fritz — delidded die macro photography
ea3813a0-0a80-4f6f-ae21-d388eb38832a.desc: A Flickr photographer who systematically delids consumer hardware and macro-photographs the die underneath, at a time when vendors publish fewer of these images themselves.

605332d0-02ad-4b4c-a636-10a9e9bfd8f0.title: Forensic evidence photography — reference scales
605332d0-02ad-4b4c-a636-10a9e9bfd8f0.desc: Crime-scene photography's L-shaped reference scale, and a NIST-adjacent study finding the standard isn't reliably manufactured.

de93244d-d998-494f-b5d1-189b28dbc899.title: Conservation photography — raking light
de93244d-d998-494f-b5d1-189b28dbc899.desc: The oblique-lighting technique conservators use to make surface topography and damage visible, useful specifically for enclosures and installed hardware rather than bare dies.

ac09f4a5-496c-49be-9396-2d602537468c.title: Burtynsky's "Manufactured Landscapes" — a counter-example
ac09f4a5-496c-49be-9396-2d602537468c.desc: Large-format industrial-landscape photography that documents scale beautifully but argues against our restraint rule, filed here as what not to do rather than what to adopt.
